newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$8.00/cubic metre or C$1.27/barrel, to C$214.00.00/cubic metre or C$34.02/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:
Cromer light sour C$210.00/cubic metre, or C$33.39/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$190.00/cubic metre, or C$30.21/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$193.00/cubic metre, or C$30.68/barrel
